name: Honest Components, Inc
old_description: We source and supply new, obsolete, and hard-to-find board-level electronic components — all independently tested at ISO/IEC 17025-accredited labs. Every order is certified, compliant, and backed by our 90-day quality guarantee.
about:
Based in Tampa, Florida, Honest Components, Inc. operates as a woman-owned small business (WOSB) certified by the U.S. Small Business Administration. The company was built by a team with over 50 combined years of experience in electronic hardware and software, led by President Jackie Schwab, who brings more than 30 years of sales leadership and customer advocacy.

Honest Components specializes in sourcing and supplying new, obsolete, and hard-to-find board-level electronic components. Its line card includes over 50,000 part numbers from manufacturers such as AMD, Intel, and Texas Instruments, covering connectors, capacitors, microcontrollers, and memory chips. Every order undergoes third-party authentication at independent laboratories accredited to ISO/IEC 17025:2017 and AS6171, including visual inspection, X-ray imaging, decapsulation, solderability, and functional testing. The company manages the full procurement lifecycle — from vendor qualification and order management to logistics — and has supplied more than 200,000 authenticated components to date.

The distributor serves aerospace, defense, medical, and industrial customers, including OEMs and contract manufacturers with mission-critical requirements. It is ITAR registered and a member of the Government-Industry Data Exchange Program (GIDEP) to combat counterfeit parts, making it a qualified supplier for U.S. defense-related programs. Healthcare and medical equipment manufacturers also rely on its certified components for regulated applications.

Honest Components differentiates itself by bearing the cost of independent third-party testing on every order at no charge to the customer, backing each shipment with a 90-day form, fit, and function guarantee. Its WOSB certification supports supplier diversity goals, while its AS9120B and ISO 9001:2015 quality management system ensures traceability and compliance across the supply chain.
